`tools/iso_builder/Makefile`|Introduced `MIRROR_PATH ?=` and `REGISTRY_CERT ?=` variables; updated `build-ove-iso` invocation to quote pull-secret and conditionally append `--mirror-path` / `--registry-cert` args when non-empty.| |**CLI parsing & validation**
`tools/iso_builder/hack/helper.sh`|Added `--mirror-path` and `--registry-cert` flags to the parser; updated `usage()` text; added existence checks: `REGISTRY_CERT` must be a file, `MIRROR_PATH` must be a directory.| |**Build script runtime changes**
`tools/iso_builder/hack/build-ove-image.sh`|Exported `MIRROR_PATH` and `REGISTRY_CERT`; refactored podman invocation into dynamically assembled argument arrays; conditionally mounts mirror dir and registry cert into container, overrides entrypoint to run `update-ca-trust` when cert provided, and adds logic to move `appliance.iso` into `/assets` if needed. Added tracing around podman invocation.| ## Sequence Diagram ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant User participant Makefile participant Helper as helper.sh participant Builder as build-ove-image.sh participant Container as PodmanContainer User->>Makefile: make build-ove-iso MIRROR_PATH=... (constructed args) Container->>Container: run build live-iso with optional mirror & cert Container-->>Builder: produce /appliance.iso (moved to /assets/appliance.iso if needed) ``` ## Estimated code review effort 🎯 3 (Moderate) | ⏱️ ~20 minutes

In `@tools/iso_builder/hack/build-ove-image.sh`:
- Around line 92-93: The current appliance_cmd uses sh -c so the final `if … fi`
can mask failures of /openshift-appliance; update the command construction
(podman_cmd and appliance_cmd) so the shell runs with -e (e.g., use `sh -ec`) or

flag or replace the semicolon before the if-check with `&&` so failures bubble
up from /openshift-appliance.
- Around line 76-97: The current code builds podman_cmd as a string and then
uses eval, which is vulnerable to shell injection for variables like
PULL_SECRET_FILE, MIRROR_PATH, REGISTRY_CERT, and appliance_image; change
podman_cmd to a bash array (e.g., declare -a podman_cmd=( "$SUDO" podman run
--authfile "$PULL_SECRET_FILE" --rm -it --privileged --pull always --net=host -v
"$appliance_work_dir":/assets:Z --env
OPENSHIFT_INSTALL_EXPERIMENTAL_DISABLE_IMAGE_POLICY ) and append mounts/flags
safely (podman_cmd+=( -v "$MIRROR_PATH":/mirror:Z ) etc.); when REGISTRY_CERT is
set, append the entrypoint flag and pass appliance_cmd as a single quoted
argument element or convert appliance_cmd into an array too, e.g., declare -a
appliance_cmd=( build live-iso --log-level debug ) or appliance_cmd=( -c
"update-ca-trust && /openshift-appliance --dir /assets ${appliance_cmd[*]} ; if
[ -f /appliance.iso ] && [ ! -f /assets/appliance.iso ]; then mv /appliance.iso
/assets/appliance.iso; fi" ); finally run the container without eval using: set
-x; "${podman_cmd[@]}" "$appliance_image" "${appliance_cmd[@]}" (or appropriate
single-element appliance_cmd), ensuring all variable expansions are quoted.

In `@tools/iso_builder/hack/helper.sh`:
- Around line 27-28: The flag parsing for --mirror-path and --registry-cert
should validate that the next argument exists and is not another flag before
assigning to MIRROR_PATH or REGISTRY_CERT; update the parsing branch handling
--mirror-path and --registry-cert to check that "$2" is set and does not begin
with "-" (or explicitly test $# -ge 2) and if missing call the usage/error
routine instead of directly assigning $2 and shifting.

In `@tools/iso_builder/Makefile`:
- Line 30: The recipe is expanding path-valued Make variables unquoted, so paths
containing spaces will be split; update the command invoking
hack/build-ove-image.sh to wrap the path variables in quotes — specifically
quote $(PULL_SECRET_FILE) and the conditional expansions for $(MIRROR_PATH) and
$(REGISTRY_CERT) (e.g. quote the entire $(if ...) expansions or their outputs)
so the script receives each path as a single argv, leaving the rest of the flags
unchanged.
